# AI-Driven End-to-End Testing with e2e

**Source:** https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dd_qig-AS8Y/ · **Type:** Reel · **Author:** Github Signals · **Saved:** 2026-10-03

## Summary

e2e is an open-source test framework that executes web and mobile tests using natural-language goals interpreted by an AI agent. The framework records discovered interaction paths so subsequent runs replay deterministically without incurring LLM API costs until the UI changes.

## Transcript and on-screen text

GitHub - tester-army/e2e: Next-generation e2e testing framework. github.com/tester-army/e2e. e2e: Open Source AI Testing Framework. MADE BY TESTERARMY. e2e is an end-to-end testing framework for web and mobile apps. Describe a goal in natural language and an agent drives the app to reach it. Check the result with locators and assertions in the same test. Quick start: npx e2e init. e2e is the test framework that lets you drive apps with plain English. Usually writing tests means hard-coding every click, which breaks the moment the design changes. Here, you just tell an AI agent your goal, like upgrade the account, and it figures out the steps to get there. The coolest part is that it records the path it took, so the next run is instant and costs zero money until the app actually changes. It works on both websites and mobile phones, letting you verify complex flows without writing brittle code. If you want tests that think for themselves, this is a game changer.
